note: Control. Human-authored, no marker on the [A] list. The skill's own rule is that a Green paragraph is not rewritten, so the outcome under test is how LITTLE changes.
min_similarity_derivation: 0.75 is DECLARED, not measured. No corpus produced it and no reference file states it. It was written before the first run so that the campaign could not choose it, and it is not moved to make a run green: a threshold that follows the result measures nothing.
max_growth_derivation: max_growth is DECLARED, not fitted. R7 permits one lengthening edit -- adding specificity -- which on an ~80-word fixture is about one concrete detail per paragraph, so 1.15x; 1.30x where the food style applies. the control. Growth on already-clean text is the R7 failure in its purest form. The number is not moved to make a run green.
